summary: Right pleural fluid and adjacent right mid/lower lung opacity have increased.

findings.rationale: After matching the diaphragms and lateral pleural margins, the current image shows a clearly larger right dependent pleural opacity with meniscus compared with the prior; positioning is similar enough that this is not explained by technique alone.

There is denser right perihilar to lower-lung airspace opacity on the current exam, contiguous with but extending beyond the prior right-sided opacity; severe rotation and low volume are present but do not fully account for the increase.
